name: @w6w-apps/clearbit
description: Enrich people and companies, search for prospects, resolve visitor IPs, and score sign-up risk via Clearbit

w6w.longDescription:
Clearbit enriches people and companies, searches for prospects, resolves anonymous website visitors by IP, autocompletes company names, and scores sign-up risk — the classic Clearbit enrichment API that predates HubSpot's 2023 acquisition of the company.

That acquisition matters for anyone evaluating this app: new enrichment access is now sold inside HubSpot as Breeze Intelligence credits, and there is no longer a way to provision a fresh, standalone Clearbit key. This app is built for teams who already hold a legacy Secret API Key — the classic person, company, prospector, reveal and risk endpoints are still live and answer exactly as documented, and a connection test is the fastest way to confirm an existing key still carries the right scopes.

Enrichment lookups use Clearbit's synchronous streaming endpoints so a single request always resolves inline, without a webhook or a polling loop. Company-to-domain lookup and risk scoring are included as well, and autocomplete works without any credential at all, since Clearbit serves it free and keyless.
